title: Monotonicity conjecture for card values in two-person whist
statement: Consider two-person whist without the assumption of symmetry, where a player may force the opponent to discard by leading a suit in which the opponent is void. Cards are compared within the same suit according to their game-theoretic value. **Monotonicity conjecture.** A higher card is always at least as good as a smaller card in the same suit. This would provide a basic order property for card values in the more complicated nonsymmetric version of whist, whose analysis lies outside the scope of the current theory.
source_name: Johan Wästlund, “The strange algebra of combinatorial games”, arXiv:0912.0448 (2009).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0912.0448

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2009).
